queries.query: Bhola Bangladesh cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry; Bangladesh DLRS Bhola mouza map parcel API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) settlement map viewer and its current DLRS Map Portal. The official catalog contains a digitized Bhola mouza map under Bhola Sadar, but the public service is a map search/purchase catalog and no public parcel-vector API or anonymous parcel geometry route was verified.

queries.result: বাংলা সরকারি ফলাফলে DLRS-এর অনলাইন নকশা/মৌজা ম্যাপ ব্যবস্থা এবং ভূমি রেকর্ড ও জরিপের সরকারি দায়িত্ব নিশ্চিত হয়েছে। ভোলা জেলার ভোলা সদর ও ভোলা মৌজার একটি ডিজিটাইজড ম্যাপ সরকারি DLRS ক্যাটালগে পাওয়া গেছে; প্রকাশ্য সেবায় নিরাপদ পার্সেল জ্যামিতি বা স্থিতিশীল নেটিভ পার্সেল আইডি পাওয়া যায়নি।

registryCustodian: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), under the Ministry of Land, is the evidenced national cadastral/map custodian. No Bhola local registry office or local open parcel API was independently verified.

registryEvidence.viewerText: The DLRS settlement viewer exposes division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet, and dag selectors. The current JavaScript references parcel vector tiles and per-sheet GeoJSON routes, but those routes require selected internal survey/mouza identifiers and were not usable for an anonymous Bhola parcel response during this attempt.
registryEvidence.catalogEvidence: The official DLRS Map Portal returned one AVAILABLE, digitized Bhola Sadar / Bhola mouza record (map id 715700975217729000, sheet ১, surveyType UNKNOWN, thumbnail and purchase price metadata).
registryEvidence.localAdministrativeEvidence: The official location endpoints list Barishal division, Bhola district, and Bhola Sadar among Bhola upazilas. This establishes administrative coverage/catalog context, not an open city parcel layer.
